{{Quote|Captain, our rocket trooper squadron suffered heavy losses.|The officer, to Captain Brunson|<ref name="Ghosts of Geonosis" />}}
This '''Imperial officer''' served under [[Captain]] [[Brunson]] along with a second [[officer]] in her [[Arquitens-class command cruiser|''Arquitens''-class command cruiser]], reporting anything that seemed unusual to her. He got slapped by Brunson when he told her that the [[Jumptrooper|rocket trooper]] [[squad]]ron had suffered heavy losses.<ref name="Ghosts of Geonosis" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
He is voiced by [[Steve Blum]] who also voiced [[Garazeb Orrelios]].<ref name="Ghosts of Geonosis" /> The character's animation model and voice are similar to [[Commander]] [[Woldar]].<ref name="Zero Hour">{{Rebels|Zero Hour}}</ref>
